content_blocks.title: Teach Me Like I'm 10: AI-Assisted Patch Diffing

content.text: Imagine you're explaining ai-assisted patch diffing to a curious 10-year-old. Patch analysis is like a set of rules that helps computers stay safe and work together. Just like a school has rules for who can go where and do what, these rules make sure only the right people and programs can access the right things.
